facts.business: Sizemasters Technology Limited manufactures thread gauges, plain gauges, multi gauging, taper gauges, spline gauges, PCD and relation gauges.
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions that were entered into during the financial year were on an arm's length basis and were in the ordinary course of business. There are no materially significant related party transactions made by the company with related parties which may have potential conflict with the interest of the company at large.
